prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction for a production UI sprite.
Input image: the approved Club Mutant UI mockup. Extract/reconstruct ONLY its TOP LEFT music player hardware, matching that player's materials, silhouette, edge thickness, wire details, button shape and knob much more faithfully than a generic new interpretation.
Output: ONE single front-facing horizontal media player asset, no surrounding game. Genuinely transparent background. It is a wide shallow unit, about 5:1 aspect ratio, filling the width of the image. Leave a little transparent margin around wires. Orthographic/front-facing view, no perspective lean, and no other objects or specimen sheets.
Materials and form MUST match the reference: rounded worn brown-gray cast-metal faceplate with substantial soft bevel, small corner screws, faint dents and grain, black recessed green LCD, compact tactile square silver-metal buttons and a chunky round dark metal volume knob, small faded red and dusty blue cable loops exiting the edges. Tiny brown beetle at upper right above the knob and a small green indicator. Restrained warm soft light, the exact mid-90s prerendered look in the mockup, not jewel chrome or a modern flat rectangular outline.
Important for implementation: the flower will be an independently animated sprite. REMOVE the reference flower completely and leave a dark shallow circular mounting recess at the far left. No flower silhouette, petals, center or face baked into this image.
Panel layout, measured relative to the metal body's bounding box: flower recess at x=6% of width; LCD inset x=14% to 52%, y=25% to 77%; THREE equally sized raised square transport button faces centered at x=59%, 67%, and 75%, y=50%, each about 7% of body width and 54% of body height; circular volume knob centered at x=89%, y=52%, diameter about 58% of body height. Small LED above/right of knob.
LCD is completely EMPTY BLACK inside its physical recess: no text, digits, progress bars, glyphs or lights inside LCD. All three raised transport button faces are BLANK: NO play, pause, previous, next, speaker or any other symbols. No writing anywhere. The knob has a clean tiny pointer notch.
Keep every element contained in the metal body, with only cable loops and beetle outside. Each blank button face must be strongly recognizable as a raised physical square with a dark edge and bevel, as in the mockup.
Do not add a second frame, a title, labels, a computer monitor, hands, a caption, a drop shadow on an opaque background, or a checkerboard pattern. Alpha transparency outside the object, but the body and LCD stay opaque. The result will be an actual skin under interactive HTML text and buttons.
preparation: tools/prepare-terminal-player.py: crop/resize, extract existing knob and transport button; live HTML handles labels, glyphs, volume, and actions.
